english.title: Obstruct a person exercising a power of entry for the purpose of a section 71 appeal re high hedges - A-s.B.
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), an appeal having been made under section 71 of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003 in respect of a remedial notice issued under Part 8 of the Act in respect of an

(A)_[owner, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), of a domestic property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), that his reasonable enjoyment of that property was being]_
(B)_[occupier, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), of a domestic property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), that his reasonable enjoyment of that property was being]_
(C)_[owner, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), of a domestic property, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), that was for the time being unoccupied, that the reasonable enjoyment of that property by a prospective occupier of that property would be]_

adversely affected by the height of a high hedge situated on land owned or occupied by another person, intentionally obstructed a person authorised by

(D)_[the appeal authority]_
(E)_[a person appointed to determine appeals on behalf of the appeal authority]_

from entering the neighbouring land in order to obtain information required by the

(F)_[appeal authority]_
(G)_[person so appointed]_

for the purpose of determining the appeal
english.legislation: Contrary to section 74(2) and (7) of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003.

english.notes: A person authorised under this section to enter land shall, if so required, produce evidence of his authority before entering; and shall produce such evidence if required to do so at any time while he remains on the land. (section 74(4)).

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.
